sections.Profile:
Blue Chip is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams in 1976. Designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche, this machine features a business and industry theme, which was unique for the time.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Science, Original Theme, Capitalism, Jobs, Construction, Industry, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Loyd Rognan
- Design: Gordon Horlick
